title: Act: Wire round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay into App
summary: Track loading and error in App and render HeaderOverlay through the header slot.
description: Edit App.tsx: add loading and error state, replace the silent catch, and pass HeaderOverlay to GameLayout header.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows loading, round, or error
definition_of_done: App passes round, loading, error to HeaderOverlay in header slot

steps.action: Add const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true) and const [roundError, setRoundError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined). Rewrite the effect so getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch((e: unknown) => setRoundError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Round request failed')).finally(() => setLoading(false)), removing the silent .catch(() => setRound(undefined)).
steps.code: getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch((e: unknown) => setRoundError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Round request failed')).finally(() => setLoading(false));
steps.expected: State reflects pending, resolved and rejected round fetch.

steps.action: Import HeaderOverlay from './components/HeaderOverlay' and pass header={<HeaderOverlay worldTitle={world.title} round={round} loading={loading} error={roundError} />} to GameLayout, importing world from './runtime/content' (the same export useGame uses).
steps.code: <GameLayout header={<HeaderOverlay worldTitle={world.title} round={round} loading={loading} error={roundError} />} scene={...}
steps.expected: HeaderOverlay renders inside the layout main area.
